semiconductor_relevance: High — National Instruments provides automated test and measurement systems specifically designed for semiconductor applications.
summary: National Instruments Corporation, now part of Emerson’s Test & Measurement business, develops automated test and measurement systems that enhance efficiency in semiconductor testing. Their platform-based approach offers high-performance solutions for RF and mixed-signal testing, significantly improving test times for smart devices.
capabilities: Automated test systems for RF and mixed-signal applications
High-performance test solutions for smart devices
